name: Burundi
description: Burundi from its old kingdom to German and Belgian rule, independence in 1962, decades of ethnic killing, civil war and peace.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: The mwami ruled the hills of Burundi for some two centuries.

checkpoints.name: German and Belgian rule
checkpoints.note: Burundi became part of German East Africa and then, from 1916, Belgian Ruanda-Urundi.

checkpoints.name: Independence and killings
checkpoints.note: Burundi became independent in 1962. The killings of 1972 and the murder of Ndadaye in 1993 led to a long civil war.

checkpoints.name: Peace
checkpoints.note: The war ended in 2005. Nkurunziza's third term caused a crisis in 2015, and Gitega became the capital in 2019.
